name: rain flow
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中用于统计应力循环的计数方法名称。

complete_examples.text: The “rain flow” counting method is adopted to describe the stress cycles of the hazard area of the clips, and the S-N curve is used to predict the fatigue life of the clips.
The “rain flow” counting method is applied to count the number of stress cycles and determine the stress amplitude.
